acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce in a test: context on a clean checkout reports revision == HEAD commit SHA.
When a synthesized worktree tree is used, it is reported under a distinct, documented field with freshness, never as `revision`.
Spec wording and consumers (hooks, MCP) updated if the wire changes; focused tests via heavy.sh.
body: Observed 2026-10-20 by the bugs-testsource lane: `corvint context` in a clean lane worktree at commit 2b0cfce94 reported `"revision": "e5bbe7757…"`, a tree hash, rather than the commit. Agents and CEM bindings read `revision` as a commit; a tree hash cannot be resolved with `git show <rev>:path` as a commit-ish in all callers and misleads provenance. Related: V1-2080 (impact names a worktree tree hash in a refusal). Expected: `revision` is the HEAD commit when the worktree is clean; a dirty/mixed worktree reports the commit plus an explicit worktree-tree field rather than substituting the tree hash.

title: corvint context reports the worktree tree hash as `revision` instead of the commit SHA
